recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Duality, the Middle Point and Three", "body": "Chance argued that scales only balance because of a middle pillar, and Sepano agreed that three was the first primordial shape, where creation begins after a single point divides. Sepano said anyone still playing the game of duality becomes a pawn of whichever side they pick. He described attached detachment, taking part in the physical world while rising above the swing of the pendulum by going within. Chance linked the same idea to the Masonic pillars, saying he read them as pointing toward the point between them."}, {"title": "Feeling, Rhythm and Free Will", "body": "Chance argued that life runs on webs of communication, while feedback loops were an invention of cyberneticists and a form of circular logic. He said the body signals through feeling, so numbing out turns the circuitry into a linear loop. He proposed that rhythm came first as communication, then feeling, then sound, and that paying attention to the moon and nature gave a person real free will. Sepano added that beliefs can be carried in feelings rather than thoughts, and that sports psychology often overlooked this."}, {"title": "Expressing the Dark as Self Love", "body": "Chance said he was on team light but did not see the dark as evil, and argued that hard feelings should be shared with people who care rather than hidden for fear of looking imperfect. He said that once a feeling was externalized it became fuel and a road map. Sepano answered that honest, authentic expression was itself an act of self love, and he separated it from self obsession, which he described as an ego story dependent on validation and outcomes."}, {"title": "The Exile of Zero", "body": "Gabe, who had sent in the question, asked why zero was exiled from numerology, and Sepano said he had no firm answer but described it as a point of origin, all or nothing. He explained that in the Pythagorean numerology he studied, double digits are read from right to left, so a 20 meant divinity acting through emotion. Chance connected zero to the Fool and the World in tarot. When Gabe joined, he recalled a book called Zero, The Biography of a Dangerous Idea, and said that, as he understood it, the Greeks had forbidden its use."}, {"title": "Centering Before Grounding", "body": "Sepano argued that a person could be grounded in a belief that did not serve them, and gave the example of someone grounded in high intensity exercise without good technique. He said being centered came first, and described a self emanation model that began in the heart and moved outward to body, close relationships and the collective. He said a person could not fight for a cause before fighting and healing for themselves. He also outlined his ART system, which stood for aiming, resonating and tuning, in his book The ART of the Fight."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Sepano Zadeh joins Vibe Rant to get real about the errors of dogmatic and dualistic thinking, and find the fun in our web. Laugh at the darkness and penetrate all fog with your light.
